verdict.rationale: Hightouch supports trigger-based syncs ("a sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set") and journeys/AI Decisioning agents that combine audiences, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails, which enables automated actions tied to underlying data/event changes. However, there is no explicit documentation of a general-purpose event-condition-action rule builder (e.g., defining arbitrary IF-event-THEN-action logic) — the evidence shows CDC-driven syncs and journey/audience automation rather than a dedicated event-triggered rules engine. Missing for 10: explicit rule-definition UI/API for event-triggered conditional actions, and independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time event-triggered automation in production.
